requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR when handling student attendance data.
The system shall allow asynchronous updates for attendance data with a maximum update time of 3 seconds and ensure all updates are logged.
The system shall ensure that all student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict data access based on user roles while ensuring transparency.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization for accurate attendance records while optimizing resource utilization.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all access and modifications to attendance records.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process.
The system shall undergo regular security audits to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis.
